Name: Farmer Analytics
Author: OHHHlevix
Description:
Farm Analytics adds a detailed statistics and tracking system to Stardew Valley, giving you a better understanding of how your farm is performing.
Keep track of your production, sales, crops, and machines, all in one place. Check which products you manufacture the most, see how much money your farm actually earns, compare crop performance across seasons, and find out which machines are being used the most.
The mod also keeps a history of your farm's activity, allowing you to look back at previous days, seasons, and years. Based on the information collected during gameplay, it can highlight interesting patterns and provide suggestions to help you improve your farm.
Everything is accessible through an in-game menu, with organized statistics and simple navigation. No custom assets or additional visual resources are required.
Whether you enjoy optimizing your production or simply want to know how your farm is doing, Farm Analytics gives you the numbers behind your hard work.
